note: A draft of assumed values. The policy identifier and the classification words follow how DND security orders write markings; the order of the six classifications is also assumed. The identifier's OID, the caveats, the releasability rules and a versioned policy information file are not known, so the OID is a placeholder set per target system and no OID is written here. Every value is replaced by what the target system's label-policy owner supplies through the DND project technical authority (owner action a). Operational exports refuse the placeholder always, and refuse the assumed values unless your security officer records an exception.
